text: Did that freak you out?\nI'm sure it did, right?
Right?! I knew my trick would be the best!
You'll see Jeila's trick if you continue ahead,\nbut I don't think it would be scarier than mine.\nGood luck~!
What?!\nAre you saying that my trick wasn't scary?!
Ugh, that's annoying!!\nOkay whatever, just go to the next trick!
It won't be more interesting than mine anyway!\nHumph!!
How is it? It scared you right?!\nIt won't stop here!
Ughhhh, how annoying! How could you not flinch\ndespite all of that...\nIn that case, I'm going all out!!
O-oh my gosh, Jeila!\nW-why are you getting serious?!\nWe just want to scare the guest, remember?!
Just shut up!\nI've got an ace up my sleeve!\nLemme show it!!
Don't say I didn't warn ya.\nI told you the guest is powerful...
I'm sorry. I got excited while trying to scare you\nand lost control of myself...
Well, last but not least, the big trick prepared\nby Olant, Potumkin, and that weird friend of\nyours.
Compared to mine, I think it'll be lame though,\nbut just enjoy it!!
That totally sounds like something a sore loser\nwould say...
HALLOWEEN EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat all of the monsters!!
